## Change

Describe the added or corrected demonstrations.

## Source and localization checklist

- [ ] Original public source, creator and date are included.
- [ ] A concrete task/output is visible; reposts are merged.
- [ ] No invented prompt, ranking or result is added.
- [ ] English README and all ten translations are synchronized.
- [ ] Curated JSON and Markdown indexes match the case order.
- [ ] Stable anchors, source links, type/date and R2 media are checked.
- [ ] Desktop and narrow rendering is reviewed.
- [ ] Rights, attribution and correction requests are respected.
